content_data.main_message: Patient-centered innovation requires balancing regulatory excellence with speed to market. Our recent strategic pivot toward digital therapeutics demonstrates how mid-size pharma can compete by focusing on underserved therapeutic areas.
content_data.executive_insights: After leading our operations transformation over the past 18 months, I've learned that sustainable growth in pharma comes from deeply understanding patient journeys and building agile development processes that don't compromise on safety or efficacy.
